The name Acima carries the meaning “Highest, Supreme” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Acima usually hope their child will grow to embody highest, supreme and live with faith, good character and purpose.
